To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) shelf space scarcity can be used by the retailer strategically to control competition between manufacturers; (2) shelf space scarcity increases the likelihood that the manufacturer with the most profitable products will be appointed category captain; and (3) the manufacturer appointed category captain may benefit both itself and the non captain manufacturer.
shelf space scarcity can be used by a powerful retailer to control the intensity between manufacturers and to benefit from the implementation of category captainship.
shelf space scarcity has a significant impact on category management, and that category captainship has a positive impact on the category and on non captain manufacturers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the scarcity of retail shelf space impacts category management.
the implications of retail shelf space scarcity for the effectiveness of two important category management mechanisms.
the impact of limited retail shelf space on category management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the impact of shelf space scarcity on category management is ambiguous.
shelf space scarcity has a significant impact on the nature of category management, and that the nature of category captainship is significantly affected by the retailer’s power.
shelf space scarcity is detrimental to category management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
shelf space scarcity has significant implications for the success of category management mechanisms.
category management is an important strategic tool for manufacturers and retailers to influence the competitive dynamics in their categories.
shelf space scarcity has a significant impact on the nature and effectiveness of category management.
The main takeaway from our work is that
category management is a strategic tool that the retailer can use to control the competitive intensity between manufacturers and the resulting profits of manufacturers and the retailer.
the impact of shelf space scarcity on category management depends on the nature of the category.
shelf space scarcity has a profound impact on the strategic interactions between manufacturers in a category and on the conditions under which category management mechanisms emerge.
